confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for Barcelona. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season and tourist-tax and fee treatment varies. FX value came from search summaries of rba.gov.au pages, not a direct page read; the 2026-10-16 figure may be provisional because RBA rates are posted after 4pm Sydney time.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Barcelona's tourist pricing, benchmarked against other large Spanish and southern European tourist cities with similar July demand. Drink anchors are anchored to local beer prices.
